dog.description_text:
My Foster Writes:
Princess may just be the sweetest pup ever and an adopter's dream! Say her name, pull out your hands, and she'll flop onto her belly to ask for pets. Head scratches are her favorite, and she'll happily press up against you, rest her head in your lap, or lie on your feet for belly rubs. She's the perfect couch buddy for TV nights, but just as fun to jog around with. She's been the perfect first-time foster!
She's as smart as she is cute! She's a fetch champ who drops the toy right in your lap, and when no one's around to play, she tosses it in the air and chases it herself. She seems house trained, picks up new cues incredibly fast, and even knows to sit and wait excitedly when she sees her harness come out. And when she's had enough of one thing, she's easy to redirect. Although she enjoys plenty of nap time (and is happy to keep you company with her lick mat while you work), when she's ready for some attention again, she may drop a toy in your lap or find the nearest spot to you to snuggle up.
She's friendly with everyone she meets and loves keeping tabs on her humans. A home with lots of love, attention, and a balance of letting her nap, giving her long-lasting chews/puzzles, and playtime to tire her out would be perfect for her!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I'll need daily interaction with you as I get used to my new life.

I will need appropriate toys and positive outlets for my energy.
dog.name: Princess
